description: This Java class 'DisabledInjectorService' extends 'SettingInjectorService' and acts as a receiver that indicates a disabled setting status. It overrides methods to provide a summary with simulated delay and always reports the setting as disabled.

classes.name: DisabledInjectorService
classes.description: A service class that indicates a disabled setting by extending SettingInjectorService, providing custom behaviors for getting summary and enabled status.

methods.name: DisabledInjectorService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with a specific TAG identifier.

methods.name: onGetSummary
methods.description: Returns a null summary after a simulated delay; intended to provide a description of the setting status.

methods.name: onGetEnabled
methods.description: Always returns false, indicating the setting is disabled.
